subject: Reseller addendum: invoice passback, VAT carve-out & DocuSign bundle
messages:
From: Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudvendor.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reseller addendum — VAT carve-out & invoice flow

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement reviewed the MSA + order form and flagged two items in the reseller addendum that need clarification before legal signs off:

1) VAT / tax treatment when reseller invoices end customers via marketplace — Acme needs a clear carve-out and confirmation Redwood will provide invoices and supporting VAT documentation.
2) Invoice passback: Acme wants the marketplace to push detailed usage line-items and raw invoice PDFs to our AP system; they prefer an automated SFTP or webhook.

Attached are the redlines (Acme_MSAs_Redlines_v1.pdf). Can Redwood confirm whether marketplace pass-through can support the invoice webhook, and whether we can restrict audit rights to scoped requests vs. broad data access?

Best,
Maya Singh
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Retail

---
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marketplace-ops@cloudvendor.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — VAT carve-out & invoice flow

Maya —

Thanks for sending the redlines and the clear list. Quick notes from my side:
- We can support invoice webhooks with line-item detail; I’ll confirm payload and retention with Marketplace Ops and legal.
- VAT/tax carve-outs are doable as a contract-level statement but need precise language from your tax team so legal can map to responsibilities.
- Audit scope: Redwood typically limits audit rights to on-demand compliance checks with advance notice and scoped access; we can propose a timeboxed, read-only process.

I’m looping in Ben (partner agreements) and Laura (legal ops) to coordinate updated language and a DocuSign bundle so your team can sign MSA + order form + addendum together.

Next action: Ben — can you take the redlines and turn them into a marked-up addendum? Laura — can you confirm whether the webhook + SFTP option needs additional security addenda (KMS/HSM reference)?

Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marketplace-ops@cloudvendor.com
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — VAT carve-out & invoice flow

Maya / Rishi —

Attached is a first-pass redline (OrderForm_Addendum_Acme.docx). Key callouts I added:
- Section 3.2: Marketplace invoice passback: supports webhook or SFTP; sample payload attached as Annex A.
- Section 4.1: VAT responsibility language — we propose inserting the phrase: "Where reseller invoices end customers, reseller shall be responsible for local VAT and Redwood will provide transaction-level reports and standard VAT documentation on request."
- Section 6.4: Audit: limited to annual compliance reviews with 15 business days’ notice; on-demand audits require mutual agreement and scoped access.

Ben
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: OrderForm_Addendum_Acme.docx (redline)

---
From: marketplace-ops@cloudvendor.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Marketplace integration: webhook payload and retention

Rishi / Ben / Maya —

We can emit invoice webhooks with line-items. Two items for coordination:
1) Payload size: for large monthly invoices we recommend batching (we provide paging).
2) Retention: Redwood retains raw usage + invoice data 13 months by default; we can extend retention to 24 months on Dedicated/enterprise plans (additional fee).

SFTP: we support daily drops to a customer-managed SFTP if you need files landed to your AP system.

We will prepare a sample payload and SFTP spec.

OPS
Marketplace Operations

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Acme Retail <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudvendor.com
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — VAT carve-out & invoice flow

Maya —

Thanks for the patience. A few legal points before we finalize:
- VAT clause: propose the following contract language to be inserted into the addendum: "Reseller shall be responsible for collection, reporting and remittance of any VAT, sales, use or similar taxes arising from Reseller's invoicing of end customers. Redwood shall provide transaction-level reports and commercially reasonable assistance to support Reseller's tax filings."
- Data access / audit: Redwood will provide restricted, read-only access for scoped audits; any export of customer PII requires a Data Processing Addendum and at least 10 business days’ notice.
- DocuSign bundling: We can package MSA + Order Form + Addendum into a single envelope. To streamline, please confirm the Acme signatory name and authority.

Attached: suggested redline (embedded in OrderForm_Addendum_Acme.docx).

Laura Bennett
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
